<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_IncidentHandling" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/incident-handling">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_IncidentReport" name="Incident report"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IncidentHandling" name="Incident Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_IncidentReported" name="Incident reported">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_IncidentReported" messageRef="Message_IncidentReport"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogReport" name="Log report in tracking system"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignTeam" name="Assign report to appropriate team"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather necessary information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyCause" name="Identify cause of incident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProposeCorrectiveActions" name="Propose corrective actions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImplementSolution" name="Implement solution (fix, training or policy change)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUp" name="Perform follow-up to prevent recurrence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseReport" name="Close incident report"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyStakeholders" name="Notify all stakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IncidentClosed" name="Incident closed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_IncidentReported" targetRef="Task_LogReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogReport" targetRef="Task_AssignTeam"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignTeam" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_IdentifyCause"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyCause" targetRef="Task_ProposeCorrectiveActions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProposeCorrectiveActions" targetRef="Task_ImplementSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ImplementSolution" targetRef="Task_FollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_FollowUp" targetRef="Task_CloseReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_CloseReport" targetRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NotifyStakeholders" targetRef="EndEvent_IncidentClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
